Title:HEAD L - MINISTRY OF THE ENVIRONMENT
MPs Speaking:Assoc. Prof. Low Seow Chay;Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan;Dr Teo Ho Pin;Mdm Cynthia Phua;Mr Abdullah Tarmugi;Mr Andy Gan Lai Chiang (Marine Parade);Mr Ang Mong Seng;Mr Chew Heng Ching;Mr Ng Ser Miang (Nominated Member);Mr Ong Kian Min (Tampines);Mr Othman Haron Eusofe;Mr Othman Haron Eusofe (Marine Parade);Mr S Iswaran (West Coast);Mr Wee Siew Kim;Mr Zainul Abidin Rasheed (Aljunied);The Minister for the Environment (Mr Lim Swee Say);The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for the Environment (Encik Mohamad Maidin B P M)

Column: 1844

     

Environmental Performance

 

     Mr Othman Haron Eusofe:  Sir, I would like to ask the Minister the following questions.  How does our environmental performance measure up to the standards in the other major cities in the world?  For instance, for air quality, are we among the cleanest city in the world?  Are we effectively reducing carbon dioxide emissions?  I would also like to know what are the Ministry's programmes to promote greater use of green cars and clean energy.

 

     Sir, recently, several areas in the east, and particularly in my constituency, were affected by floods.  They include the Sims Avenue area, Paya Lebar, Geylang, and also in Marine Drive in the Marine Parade constituency.  Businesses were disrupted, cars were damaged and goods destroyed.  At the recent Environment press briefing, it was reported that the Government has invested $1.5 billion to improve Singapore's drainage system over several years.  My question is: why is our drainage system unable to prevent the recent floods?  And it was also reported that next week, from 21st to 23rd March, there will be exceptionally high tide again, and that there may be a recurrence of floods in the affected areas.  So, I would like to know what measures the Ministry of the Environment and the PUB will take to advise the public and to get them to prepare, in case floods occur, and what would be the flood prevention measures that would be implemented.
